app.name: Tesla Charger Monitoring
layout.insecure_http: This connection is not encrypted (plain HTTP). Anyone on your network could read your password. Enable HTTPS (TCMON_TLS=auto).
layout.footer_version_html: Tesla Charger Monitoring {version} · Source code (AGPL-3.0-or-later)
layout.footer_trademark: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. “Tesla” and “Wall Connector” are trademarks of Tesla, Inc.
login.title: Sign in
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device for 30 days
login.forgot_html: Forgot it? Run tcmon reset-password in the container shell (TrueNAS: Apps → tcmon → Shell).
setup.title: Set your password
setup.intro: Enter the one-time setup token printed in the container log (TrueNAS: Apps → tcmon → Logs), then choose a password of at least {min} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.
setup_closed.title: Setup is closed
setup_closed.body_html: The setup token has expired. Restart the app to get a new token in the log, or set the password with tcmon reset-password in the container shell.
security.title: Security
security.env_managed_html: The password is set by TCMON_PASSWORD_FILE or TCMON_PASSWORD_HASH. Change it there and restart the app.
security.change_hint: Changing the password signs out every other device.
about.title: About
about.license_text: GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version. If you run a modified version as a network service, you must offer its source code to its users.
about.fingerprint_hint: Compare with the fingerprint your browser shows for this site and with the one in the container log.
about.certificate_download: Download to trust it on your devices
about.disclaimer: Tesla Charger Monitoring is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. “Tesla” and “Wall Connector” are trademarks of Tesla, Inc.
home.title: Dashboard
home.empty_body: Enter its IP address (find it in your router's list of connected devices or in the Tesla One app, and reserve it there so it doesn't change).
home.meter_label: Current as a percentage of the maximum
device.no_events: No reboots, firmware or configuration changes seen.
device.raw_title: Latest raw responses from the Wall Connector
devices.title: Wall Connectors
device_form.name: Name
device_form.address_hint: Find it in your router's list of connected devices or in the Tesla One app, and reserve it in the router so it doesn't change.
device_form.breaker_hint: The maximum current defaults to 80 % of this (60 A → 48 A).
device_form.plugged_interval: While a car is plugged in, poll every (minutes)
device_form.fast_when_plugged: Poll more often while a car is plugged in
device_form.allow_non_lan: Allow an address outside the local network (not recommended)
device_form.remove_body: This permanently deletes all of its readings, alerts and history.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.snooze_hint: Alerts are still recorded while snoozed; only notifications are held back.
rule.uncalibrated: The thresholds for this rule have not been calibrated against real charging data yet and may alert during normal charging (see issue #1).
rule.preview_none: With these settings this rule would not have produced any notification in the last 24 hours.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty_body_html: Alerts are recorded but not sent anywhere. Add your Gmail address to receive them by email. You'll need a Google app password (2-Step Verification must be on).
channel.name: Name
channel.password_set: A password is stored (encrypted). Leave empty to keep it.
channel.password_hint_html: Create one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (needs 2-Step Verification). Your normal Gmail password will not work.
channel.to_hint: One or more addresses, separated by commas.
channel.quiet_hours_hint: Optional. Non-critical alerts are not emailed during this window (they stay in the history).
channel.digest_hint_html: Also send a summary every Monday morning: last week's charging energy and cost, alerts, and Wall Connector health. Sent regardless of the minimum severity and quiet hours. Preview
digest.intro: Email channels with “Weekly summary” turned on receive this every Monday at {hour}:00, covering the previous Monday to Sunday. The email itself is formatted; this is its plain-text version.
settings.title: Settings
settings.db_size_oldest: Database size {size}, oldest reading {time}. Hourly polling stores about 16 MB per year.
settings.db_size: Database size {size}. Hourly polling stores about 16 MB per year.
settings.confirm_delete: I understand that shorter retention permanently deletes older data
settings.beat_intro:
Optional. tcmon visits this address after each successful poll, so a monitoring service such as healthchecks.io or Uptime Kuma (push monitor) can warn you if tcmon stops working or can no longer reach the Wall Connector.
    Set the service's period or grace time longer than the polling interval: at least 70 minutes with the default 60-minute polling.
settings.beat_off: Off: no ping URL is set.
settings.beat_url_hint: HTTPS only. Stored encrypted and never shown again, because it usually contains a secret token.
settings.beat_keep: Leave empty to keep the current one.
settings.backup_body_html: Download a consistent copy of the database. Also keep a copy of secret.key (encrypts the email password and the ping URL) and the tls folder from the data directory.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.quality_ok: The latest responses matched the expected format exactly.
diagnostics.beat_set_html: . Set a ping URL in Settings.
diagnostics.db_summary: Size {size} · schema version {schema} · {go} · {clients} live browser connection(s)
costs.title: Charging costs
costs.intro: Price: {rate}. Energy is measured by the Wall Connector, which is what your utility bills; your car may show a little less because of charging losses. Days follow the server's time zone ({tz}).
costs.download_daily: Download daily kWh and cost (CSV, last 365 days)
costs.sessions_hint: Start and end times are accurate to the polling interval (5 minutes while a car is plugged in).
energy.title: Electricity price
energy.default: Using the default price of $0.155 per kWh until you save one.
energy.apply_past: Apply to all past data too
energy.fee_hint: Added once to each month with charging. Leave 0 to count energy only.
energy.offpeak_hint: Leave empty for a single flat price.
energy.history_hint: Each price applies from its date until the next one. The earliest price also covers any older data.
flash.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
flash.device_saved: Wall Connector saved. It will be polled right away.
flash.polling: Polling now. The page updates when the result arrives.
flash.poll_limited: A poll was just requested; wait a few seconds before asking again.
flash.rule_reset: Alert rule reset to its defaults.
flash.test_sent: Test email sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
flash.digest_sent: Weekly summary sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
flash.beat_saved: Ping URL saved. tcmon pings it after each successful poll.
flash.beat_tested: Test ping sent. Check that your monitoring service received it.
flash.beat_removed: Ping URL removed; pings are off.
flash.rate_saved: Electricity price saved. Costs are recalculated from it.
flash.sessions_revoked: All other devices have been signed out.
error.signed_out: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.csrf: The form expired or did not come from this app. Reload the page and try again.
login.form_expired: The sign-in form expired. Please try again.
error.title: Error
login.internal_error: Sign-in failed because of an internal error. See the container log.
setup.form_expired: The setup form expired. Please try again.
setup.internal_error: Setup failed because of an internal error. See the container log.
security.internal_error: The password could not be changed because of an internal error.
security.revoke_failed: Could not sign out other devices.
error.no_cert: HTTPS is terminated by a proxy.
error.not_found: There is no page at this address.
error.cross_origin: This form was submitted from another website and was blocked for your protection.
error.lan_only: Forbidden: this service is only available on the local network.
error.misdirected: Misdirected request: add this host name to TCMON_PUBLIC_HOSTNAMES.
costs.summary: Charging cost per {period}, {range}: total {total} for {kwh} kWh, highest {max}.
energy.err_price: Enter the price per kWh as a number, e.g. 0.155.
energy.err_fee: The monthly fee must be a number.
energy.err_offpeak: For off-peak pricing enter a price and different start and end times (HH:MM).
energy.err_from: Choose the date the price starts.
energy.err_currency: The currency symbol must be 1–4 characters, e.g. $ or €.
error.no_device: That Wall Connector does not exist.
device_form.probe_not_wc: Something answered at {address}, but it does not look like a Tesla Wall Connector.
device_form.probe_blocked: That address is not on your local network. Tick “allow an address outside the local network” only if you are sure.
device_form.probe_none: No Wall Connector answered at {address}. Check the IP address (your router's DHCP list or the Tesla One app) and that it is on Wi-Fi.
device_form.err_confirm: To delete, type the device name exactly. This removes all of its history.

alerts.err_snooze_input: Choose a device and a duration.
rule.err_timing: Timing fields must be non-negative numbers.
settings.keep_readings_help: Every poll's measurements (charts use hourly summaries beyond this). Energy counter readings that charging costs need are always kept.
settings.keep_raw_help: Exact JSON from the Wall Connector, for diagnostics.
settings.err_retention: Retention values must be whole numbers of days.
settings.err_confirm_delete: Shorter retention permanently deletes older data at the next nightly cleanup. Download a backup first if you may need it, then tick the confirmation box.
settings.backup_err_temp: Could not create a temporary file.

alert_rule.device_unreachable.title: Wall Connector unreachable
alert_rule.device_unreachable.desc: A poll failed after all retries. Escalates to critical after several consecutive failed polls.
alert_rule.device_unreachable.message: No response from {address} ({count} failed poll(s)). If its IP address changed, update it in Settings.
alert_rule.handle_temp_high.title: Handle temperature high
alert_rule.handle_temp_high.desc: Handle temperature above the warning or critical threshold.
alert_rule.pcba_temp_high.title: Circuit board temperature high
alert_rule.pcba_temp_high.desc: Circuit board (PCBA) temperature above the warning or critical threshold.
alert_rule.mcu_temp_high.title: Controller temperature high
alert_rule.mcu_temp_high.desc: Controller (MCU) temperature above the warning or critical threshold.
alert_rule.thermal_foldback.title: Thermal foldback
alert_rule.thermal_foldback.desc: The Wall Connector reduced charging current because it got too hot.
alert_rule.thermal_foldback.message: {count} new thermal foldback(s) — charging current was reduced due to heat (lifetime total {total})
alert_rule.device_alert_active.title: Wall Connector reports an alert
alert_rule.device_alert_active.desc: The device's current_alerts list is not empty.
alert_rule.device_alert_count_up.title: New device alert recorded
alert_rule.device_alert_count_up.message: {count} new alert(s) recorded by the Wall Connector (lifetime total {total})
alert_rule.not_ready_reasons.title: Car plugged in but not ready
alert_rule.not_ready_reasons.desc: The Wall Connector reports unusual not-ready reasons while a car is connected and not charging. (The reasons a UWC normally reports while unplugged, charging, or plugged in and idle are ignored.)
alert_rule.grid_voltage_out_of_range.des: Grid voltage deviates from the configured nominal voltage.
alert_rule.grid_voltage_out_of_range.mes: Grid voltage {value} V is {deviation} % above nominal {nominal} V
Grid voltage {value} V is {deviation} % below nominal {nominal} V
alert_rule.grid_freq_out_of_range.title: Grid frequency out of range
alert_rule.grid_freq_out_of_range.desc: Grid frequency deviates from nominal (50/60 Hz).
alert_rule.phase_current_imbalance.title: Phase current imbalance
alert_rule.phase_current_imbalance.desc: Three-phase installations only: phase currents differ while charging.
alert_rule.phase_current_imbalance.messa: Phase currents differ by {pct} % (A {a} / B {b} / C {c} A)
alert_rule.overcurrent.title: Overcurrent
alert_rule.overcurrent.desc: Charging current exceeds the configured maximum current plus a margin.
alert_rule.overcurrent.message: Current {current} A exceeds the {max} A maximum (limit {limit} A)
alert_rule.current_near_limit.title: Charging at maximum current
alert_rule.current_near_limit.desc: Informational: charging at or just above the configured maximum current.
alert_rule.charging_stalled.title: Charging stalled
alert_rule.charging_stalled.desc: Contactor closed and car connected, but almost no current flows.
alert_rule.charging_stalled.message: Charging session active but current is only {current} A
alert_rule.relay_voltage_abnormal.title: Relay voltage abnormal
alert_rule.relay_voltage_abnormal.desc: Relay drive voltage (UWC: K1/K2, Gen 3: coil) outside the expected band, the two relays disagree, or a relay shows voltage while the contactor is open (possible stuck relay). Not calibrated for the UWC: a real charging capture showed K1 5.8 V and K2 0.0 V with the contactor closed, outside the default band.
alert_rule.relay_voltage_abnormal.messag: Relay shows {voltage} V while the contactor is open (possible stuck relay)
Relay K1/K2 voltages differ by {diff} V
alert_rule.wifi_weak.title: Weak Wi-Fi signal
alert_rule.wifi_weak.desc: Wi-Fi RSSI below the threshold on consecutive polls.
alert_rule.wifi_no_internet.title: No internet connection
alert_rule.wifi_no_internet.desc: The Wall Connector reports no internet access (needed for firmware updates).
alert_rule.wifi_no_internet.message: The Wall Connector has no internet connection
alert_rule.unexpected_reboot.title: Wall Connector rebooted
alert_rule.unexpected_reboot.desc: The device uptime reset since the previous poll.
alert_rule.unexpected_reboot.message: The Wall Connector restarted (uptime now {uptime} s)
alert_rule.firmware_changed.title: Firmware updated
alert_rule.grid_profile_changed.title: Grid profile changed
alert_rule.grid_profile_changed.desc: An IEEE 1547 grid-interconnection checksum changed (trip/ride-through settings).
alert_rule.grid_profile_changed.message: Grid profile (IEEE 1547) settings changed: VfTrips {vf_trips_from}→{vf_trips_to}, RideThru {ride_thru_from}→{ride_thru_to}, Combined {combined_from}→{combined_to}
alert_rule.identity_mismatch.title: Different Wall Connector at this address
alert_rule.identity_mismatch.desc: The serial number at the configured address changed.
alert_rule.identity_mismatch.message: A different Wall Connector (serial {serial}, was {previous}) answered at this address — check the IP address in Settings
alert_rule.contactor_wear.title: Contactor wear milestone
alert_rule.contactor_wear.desc: The number of contactor cycles under load crossed a milestone.
alert_rule.contactor_wear.message: Contactor has completed {cycles} switching cycles under load
alert_rule.err_timing: rule {rule}: for ≤ 24 h, cooldown/repeat ≤ 7 days, repeat ≥ 15 min
alert_rule.err_warn_above_crit: rule {rule}: warning threshold must be below critical
alerts.err_quiet_hours: alerts: quiet hours must look like 22:00-07:00, got {value}
alerts.err_quiet_hours_equal: alerts: quiet hours start and end are equal

notify.err_password_required: a password (Gmail: app password) is required when a username is set

notify.hint_auth_rejected: The username or password was rejected. For Gmail, use your full address and a 16-character app password, not your normal password.
notify.hint_recipient_rejected: A recipient address was rejected by the mail server. Check the To addresses.
notify.hint_auth_required: The server requires authentication. Enter a username and password.
notify.hint_message_rejected: The message was rejected. For Gmail, the From address must be your Gmail address or a verified alias.

notify.hint_dns: The mail server name could not be resolved. Check the SMTP server and the container's DNS.
notify.hint_timeout: Timed out connecting to the mail server. Check the port and that outbound SMTP is allowed.
notify.hint_refused: Connection refused. Check the SMTP server and port.
